name: 完了比率を持つ案件グループ
prompt:
Use case: text-localization / ui-mockup. LH09-0047: one Japanese project task group with completion summary.
Use ORIGINAL image2 component crop as edit base and image1 original screen for context. Originals PRIMARY for icon shape/stroke/optical weight, proportions, spacing, table geometry, fine details, Jane's original portrait artwork. Preserve the original photo pixels/appearance in BOTH assignee cells, do not invent a replacement face or initials. Image3 mock SECONDARY Japanese copy guide; its diamond, circle, club, square, relation-arrow substitutes and mint initial avatars are wrong.
Group header: downward triangle, original circled-right-arrow (forest green), underlined「礼拝の準備」, count2, ellipsis, plus. Six headers with original glyphs Aa/status-radial/people/calendar/up-right-arrow/up-right-arrow and labels「作業名」「状態」「担当者」「期日」「期間」「案件」.
Exactly TWO rows:「担当者を招待する」/「未着手」/ original portrait plus「山田 花子」/「2026年4月15日」/ original walking glyph plus underlined「準備期間 3」/ circled arrow plus underlined「礼拝の準備」.
Second row「準備用の資料を追加する」/「完了」/ same original portrait and「山田 花子」/ same date / same period / same project.
Unstarted white neutral pill+gray dot; completed white pill+forest-green dot/text, preserve semantic distinction. Following row thin plus and「新しい作業」. Footer beneath status column「完了 1/2」. Restore all original controls; no new data or artwork.
Official white canvas and white ordinary surfaces, subtle neutral grid, compact horizontal proportions and original row heights. Meiryo Regular14/24, metadata12/16, tracking0; no bold title/body. Slate supporting glyphs #526173. No broad mint panels or decorative containers; no extra outer card. Output only this complete group, all Japanese text readable and unclipped.
reviewNotes: Two rows, all Japanese values and completion1/2 checked; source icon anatomy restored. Output retains blue relation arrows/tinted pills, light walking glyphs and heavier type; portraits synthesized. Needs correction.
